title: GATEAU: Selecting Influential Samples for Long Context Alignment
authors_zh: Shuzheng Si, Haozhe Zhao, Gang Chen, Yunshui Li, Kangyang Luo, Chuancheng Lv, Kaikai An, Fanchao Qi, Baobao Chang, Maosong Sun
paper_type_zh: 长上下文指令数据选择研究
best_for_zh: 筛选必须教会真实长程依赖使用的长指令数据的读者。
one_line: GATEAU selects long SFT records using context-window perplexity gaps and attention-relevance alignment.
GATEAU 以上下文窗口困惑度差和注意力—相关性对齐选择长监督微调记录。
why: It turns long-range dependence into an explicit criterion for which records are admitted to long-context SFT.
inclusion_reason: It selects the long instruction-response records consumed by SFT according to evidence of long-range dependency use.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Synthetic long instruction data can have very long inputs without requiring a model to use them. A response may depend only on a nearby passage, or the input may contain unrelated concatenated material. Training uniformly on such records can spend a long-context SFT budget on examples that do not teach retrieval across distance, even when the underlying model has an extended context window.

GATEAU asks which long instruction-response records should be admitted to alignment training when the desired capability is modeling meaningful long-range dependencies. The data decision is selection from a 10K synthetic long-instruction pool, followed by ordinary SFT. The paper targets records where long context makes both response generation and input understanding genuinely difficult, rather than merely preferring greater sequence length.

合成长指令数据可以有很长的输入，却不要求模型真正使用它们。一个回答可能只依赖指令附近的段落，或输入可能由无关材料拼接而成。均匀训练这类记录会把长上下文监督微调预算花在不能教会跨距离检索的例子上，即使底层模型已经有扩展的上下文窗口。

GATEAU 追问当目标能力是建模有意义的长程依赖时，哪些长指令—回答记录应被准入对齐训练。数据决策是从 10K 合成长指令池中选择，再进行普通监督微调。论文针对的是让长上下文同时真正增加回答生成和输入理解难度的记录，而不是只偏好更长序列。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Homologous Models' Guidance compares response perplexities from two otherwise similar base models with short and long context windows. A large normalized difference is interpreted as evidence that the response becomes easier specifically when a model can use long-range context. This separates context-dependent generation difficulty from general instruction-following weakness better than a single model's perplexity.

Contextual Awareness Measurement divides the input into segments, estimates each segment's relevance to the reference response, and compares that relevance pattern with the long-context model's attention pattern. When attention is poorly aligned with important segments, the record is scored as difficult to understand through long-range relations. A weighted sum of the two scores ranks records; high-scoring records are selected for SFT as influential long samples.

同源模型引导比较两个其他方面相似、但上下文窗口一短一长的基础模型给出的回答困惑度。较大的归一化差异被解释为：当模型能利用长程上下文时，回答会明显变得容易。这比单一模型的困惑度更能将依赖上下文的生成难度与一般指令遵循薄弱区分开。

上下文感知测量把输入切成段，估计每段对参考回答的相关性，并将该相关性模式与长上下文模型的注意力模式比较。当注意力与重要段落对齐较差时，该记录被评分为难以通过长程关系理解。两项分数的加权和对记录排序；高分记录作为有影响力的长样本被选入监督微调。

title: Method
方法
html:
For HMG, the authors normalize response perplexity across LongAlign for LLaMA-2-7B-base-4K and its 64K homologous model, then take their difference. For CAM, the 64K model computes response-conditioned attention for equal-length input segments; segment importance comes from response perplexity when that segment alone is retained. Cosine similarity between normalized importance and attention vectors yields the contextual-awareness score. Both scores are normalized over the pool before weighting.

The main pool is LongAlign, 10K long samples synthesized from documents from nine sources with Claude 2.1; ShareGPT short instructions are mixed during final training to retain ordinary assistant behavior. The paper selects the top 10%, 30%, or 50% of long records and SFTs LLaMA-2-7B-base-64K, with additional 13B, ChatGLM3, and LLaMA3 analyses. It compares full LongAlign, raw perplexity, CaR, and Cherry Selection on LongBench, LongBench-Chat, and MT-Bench. Official code and selected long data are linked by the authors.

对于同源模型引导，作者归一化 LLaMA-2-7B-base-4K 和其 64K 同源模型在 LongAlign 上的回答困惑度，再取二者差异。对于上下文感知测量，64K 模型计算等长输入段的回答条件注意力；段的重要性来自只保留该段时生成参考回答的困惑度。归一化重要性与注意力向量的余弦相似度形成上下文感知分数。两项分数都在全池上归一化后加权。

主池是 LongAlign，包含 10K 条长样本，由九个来源的文档用 Claude 2.1 合成；最终训练混入 ShareGPT 短指令以保留普通助手行为。论文选择前 10%、30% 或 50% 长记录，对 LLaMA-2-7B-base-64K 进行监督微调，并额外分析 13B、ChatGLM3 和 LLaMA3。它在 LongBench、LongBench-Chat 和 MT-Bench 上与完整 LongAlign、原始困惑度、CaR 和 Cherry Selection 比较。作者链接了官方代码和所选长数据。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
With only 10% selected long records in the real-world setting, GATEAU-LLaMA reports 55.4 on LongBench-Chat and 58.6 on MT-Bench, versus 48.8 and 54.3 for full 100% LongAlign SFT. In the limited-short-instruction setting, the corresponding 10% scores are 58.0 and 53.4, versus 50.8 and 47.7 for full training. The 10% selected model also reaches a 56.1 LongBench average in the real-world setting, compared with 49.3 for full training.

Both components matter in the 7B and 13B ablations. For the 7B real-world 50% run, the full method reports LongBench single-document, multi-document, and summarization values of 38.9, 25.8, and 25.5, whereas removing CAM gives 38.4, 24.3, and 25.1 and removing HMG gives 38.6, 24.5, and 24.9. The paper finds 30% often gives the best LongBench balance and reports selected samples outperforming short-context selectors at equal ratios. These are benchmark and GPT-4-based evaluations of a particular synthetic pool, not a proof that every high score is a faithful long-dependency example.

在真实世界设置中，仅用 10% 所选长记录的 GATEAU-LLaMA 在 LongBench-Chat 和 MT-Bench 上报告 55.4 和 58.6，而完整 100% LongAlign 监督微调为 48.8 和 54.3。在短指令受限设置中，相应 10% 分数为 58.0 和 53.4，而完整训练为 50.8 和 47.7。10% 所选模型在真实世界设置中还达到 56.1 的 LongBench 平均，而完整训练为 49.3。

两个组成部分在 7B 和 13B 消融中都很重要。对 7B 真实世界 50% 运行，完整方法报告 LongBench 单文档、多文档和摘要值为 38.9、25.8 和 25.5，去掉上下文感知测量后为 38.4、24.3 和 25.1，去掉同源模型引导后为 38.6、24.5 和 24.9。论文发现 30% 常给出最佳 LongBench 平衡，并报告在相同比例下所选样本优于短上下文选择器。这些是对特定合成池的基准和 GPT-4 评测，并非证明每个高分记录都是忠实的长依赖例子。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Conventional instruction selectors can rank difficulty, quality, or diversity without asking whether a long input is causally necessary for its response. GATEAU makes long-range dependence the selection target. It uses the gap between homologous context-window models to isolate context-sensitive generation, then separately asks whether a long-context model attends to segments that matter for the reference answer.

The method's novelty is the intersection of those two criteria before a record becomes SFT supervision. A long example with a hard response but no context-window benefit is not the intended target; neither is a long example whose attention is incoherent relative to segment relevance. This is therefore a data-consumption policy for long-context alignment, not an architecture change or a generic high-perplexity filter.

常规指令选择器可以按难度、质量或多样性排序，却不询问长输入是否对回答具有因果必要性。GATEAU 让长程依赖成为选择目标。它利用同源上下文窗口模型之间的差距隔离对上下文敏感的生成，并单独询问长上下文模型是否注意到对参考答案重要的段落。

该方法的新意在于让记录成为监督微调之前必须同时满足这两个准则。一条回答困难却没有上下文窗口收益的长例子不是预期目标；一条相对于段落相关性注意力不连贯的长例子也不是。因此这是服务于长上下文对齐的数据消费策略，而不是结构改变或通用的高困惑度过滤。

title: Limitations
局限
html: HMG requires a homologous short-window and long-window pair, restricting use where such checkpoints do not exist or cannot be accessed. CAM depends on attention as a usable indicator of contextual use and requires repeated long-context computation, so selection is not inexpensive. The work focuses on overall instruction following and long-context understanding, rather than specialized task performance, and its central pool is Claude 2.1-synthesized LongAlign. The authors note that performance can decline when all high-scoring data are used or when data quality is mixed, so the selected fraction and source distribution need validation instead of assuming more selected records are always better.

同源模型引导需要一对短窗口和长窗口的同源检查点，限制了没有这类检查点或无法访问它们时的使用。上下文感知测量依赖注意力作为上下文使用的可用指示，并需要重复的长上下文计算，因此选择并不便宜。工作聚焦总体指令遵循和长上下文理解，而非专业任务表现，且其中心池是 Claude 2.1 合成的 LongAlign。作者指出，当使用全部高分数据或混合质量数据时性能可能下降，因此必须验证所选比例和来源分布，而不能假定更多所选记录总会更好。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use GATEAU when a long-context SFT pool contains candidate records with a reference response and one needs evidence that the response uses distant context. Preserve both homologous checkpoints, tokenization and normalization, segment length, attention aggregation, the HMG/CAM weight, pool version, selected IDs, ratio, ShareGPT mixture, and SFT recipe. Compare against full-pool, length-matched random, and single-score selection at equal long-token budgets. The official repository supplies the released code and selected data, but upstream LongAlign and ShareGPT provenance, licenses, and synthetic-answer risks still need separate review.

当长上下文监督微调池含有带参考回答的候选记录，且需要证明回答使用远距离上下文时，可使用 GATEAU。应保留两种同源检查点、分词和归一化、段长度、注意力聚合、同源模型引导与上下文感知测量的权重、数据池版本、所选标识、比例、ShareGPT 混合和监督微调配方。应在相同长词元预算下同完整池、长度匹配随机和单分数选择比较。官方仓库提供发布代码和所选数据，但上游 LongAlign 与 ShareGPT 的来源、许可和合成回答风险仍需单独审查。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The paper's two scores answer different counterfactual questions. HMG asks whether a longer-window homologous model changes the likelihood of the target response; CAM asks whether the long model appears to place attention where the response-relevant segments are. Neither score alone defines data quality. The most informative evidence is the selected-fraction comparison, where 10–30% can outperform the full long pool, and the ablation showing each score adds value. Treat the result as guidance for this particular notion of long-context supervision, not as a general ranking of all instruction data.
论文的两项分数回答不同的反事实问题。同源模型引导询问更长窗口的同源模型是否改变目标回答的似然；上下文感知测量询问长模型是否看似把注意力放在与回答相关的段落上。任一分数单独都不定义数据质量。最有信息量的证据是选择比例比较，其中 10–30% 可胜过完整长池，以及显示每项分数都带来价值的消融。应把结果视为对这一特定长上下文监督概念的指导，而非所有指令数据的通用排名。
